API Client
===================================================

**api_client**

.. note::
    This describes a working state under active development.

Kiutra devices host a JSON-RPC server. By sending remote procedure calls using the JSON-RPC protocol, kiutra devices can be
interfaced from different programming languages. Messages to the server must be formatted in the form of
*device*.\ **key**, where **key** can be one of the documented keywords and *device* is the device instance identifier respectively.
The keywords are the names of the respective client implementation.
To query a value use the remote procedure **read**, to set a value use **write** and to execute a procedure use **call**.
Available commands can be found in the code documentation by clicking on [source] of the according section.
Device name plus property/method name yield the api handle.

.. |kiutra_link| raw:: html

   <a href="http://kiutra.com" target="_blank">kiutra.com</a>

A basic client object to control the temperature may be created by simply following the code example given in the documentation of *KiutraClient*.

   :members:
